title: dm_query_json response
description: What dm_query_json returns for each query. A failure is a dm_status with a message on dm_last_error rather than an error object here: DM_ERR_INVALID_ARG for a malformed request or unknown query, DM_ERR_NOT_FOUND for a path that is not in the tree. An empty result is DM_OK with an empty array, since a type with no subtypes is an answer.

truncated.description: True when the limit cut the list short. Reported rather than inferred from the count, because a list exactly as long as the limit looks identical to one that was cut.

types.description: Flat and in tree order. The type asked about is not included.

declared.description: False for a node that exists only because something deeper was declared: /obj/item/sword alone brings /obj/item into being.

parentType.description: Where the type INHERITS from, which is not always its path parent - /mob is a child of the root by path and inherits from /atom/movable. Null at the root.

childCount.description: How many children exist, which is not the length of "children" when depth cut the response short. This is what lets a panel draw an expander without a second call.

detail.description: The declaration as written: a signature for a proc, the declared type for a var.

kind.description: dm_symbol_kind, the same values dm_document_symbols uses.

inherited.description: True when the member is declared on an ancestor rather than on the type asked about.

owner.description: The type the member is declared on.

file.description: Empty for a builtin, since nothing in the project declares it.
